shots.vo: My last couple of videos were all edited by Claude.
shots.edit_note: Mid shot to camera. Headline holds 4s.

shots.vo: See, the noobs would have just told Claude to edit the whole video in one prompt
shots.edit_note: Claude chat: one message, 'edit my whole video', send.

shots.vo: and then spent the rest of the day trying to fix it.
shots.edit_note: Fix requests pile up in the thread, faster and faster.

shots.vo: But here's how the pros do it.
First things first, you need a script. Take your time.
shots.edit_note: Claude Code drafting script.md on top, face box below.

shots.vo: Cook it up and then throw it on the storyboard.
shots.edit_note: The script lands on the board: one row per line.

shots.vo: Every single line of the script gets its own frame.
shots.edit_note: Frames drop into each row, top to bottom.

shots.vo: What's on screen, what the text says and what the sound is.
shots.edit_note: Push in on one row; ring the Frame, Text and SFX cells as they're named.

shots.vo: Because the storyboard is the prompt.
Second, you have Claude build out every graphic one at a time.
shots.edit_note: Claude Code building shot 4 from the board, face box below.

shots.vo: Take your time, straight off that storyboard.
shots.edit_note: Side by side: the frame, then the built graphic matching it.

shots.vo: Third, the first version is never right, so you throw it in Premiere
and go back and forth with Claude until it matches the frame, or something that you like.
shots.edit_note: Premiere on top, two quick revisions swap in; face box below.

shots.vo: Then you render it, do your polish, your captions, your sound, and your color.
shots.edit_note: Fast cuts: render bar, captions, audio meters, color wheels.

shots.vo: See the noobs just prompt it, but the pros storyboard it.
Comment storyboard and I'll send you my storyboard skill.
shots.edit_note: Close shot. Keyword spoken, captions only.
